messages:
Harley: Quick thread — prepping the Northbridge QBR (next Wed). Need: slide owners, a tight renewal-status blurb, and one clear exec ask. Can we assign now?

Sam: I can own the onboarding status + rollout metrics. Will call out the two pilots that cant scale due to capacity pool limits.

Nora: Ill draft the renewal snapshot and mitigation bullets. Planning to highlight SSO, data residency clarity, and capacity gating. Will post draft tonight.

Ivan: Ill take the action tracker and enablement gaps slide. Summary in deck, full timeline in runbook. Please put owners on each item.

Priyanka: Ill add a short customer quote and usage sparkline to the openslide. Dropping assets into the shared deck now.

Harley: Runbook link: https://redwood.app/s/nb-qbr-runbook-compact (appendix slide 9). Final deck Tue 10:30am PT, dry run Tue 2pm PT, exec Wed 11am PT. If slide missing by 10:30am Ill reassign.

notify-bot: Template v2 synced at 2212345800 -> /decks/templates/qbr-2025-v2.

Sam: Onboarding note: 5 pilots, 2 blocked by capacity pool limits in eu-west-1. Proposed exec ask: "Authorize a temporary capacity burst (48-72h) to unblock pilot scale." Adding to slide.

Nora: Draft renewal snapshot:
"Account health: 71/100. Main renewal risks: 1) SSO integration lag delaying onboarding; 2) unclear data residency/retention terms for compliance sign-off; 3) capacity pool limits preventing pilot growth. With targeted executive action on capacity and a short SSO sprint, renewal probability improves materially."

Ivan: Action items (deck summary):
- Nora: mitigation bullets + owner matrix (Mon EOD)
- Sam: onboarding slide + exact infra error (Tue 9:30am)
- Ivan: action tracker + appendix pointer (Tue 10am)
- Priyanka: quote + visuals (pushed)
- Harley: update CRM stage & book dry run (Tue)

Priyanka: Short quote for exec slide: "Integration progress positive; waiting on capacity to finish rollout." Full quote in appendix.

Sam: Infra snippet for appendix (confirming with infra): `ERROR: capacity pool depleted: requested 12 vCPUs in eu-west-1, available 0`. Will paste final log.

Nora: Mitigation ask for exec slide (one-liner): "Approve temporary capacity burst and 2 sprints of prioritized SSO work to remove blockers."

Harley: CRM note: Ill flip SFDC to "At Risk - Exec Assist" after Nora posts the final mitigation text, and will loop in Sales Ops for the capacity justification.

Ivan: Uploaded action tracker and linked appendix slide 12. Added ARR impact bullets for the exec note.

Sam: Aim to have onboarding slide uploaded by Tue 9am so theres time for review.

Nora: Posting mitigation text in 30m for quick review.

Harley: Thanks team  dry run reminder Tue 2pm PT. Tagging for visibility: @Sam @Nora @Ivan @Priyanka. :raised_hands:

(3 reactions: :white_check_mark: :eyes: :thumbsup:)
